lines.text: As soon as I touch your hand, I get all drowsy. Pretty weird, don't ya think?
Looks like I've been shedding a lot recently!
I look a lot like a puppy, don't ya think?
Commander! I cracked the case today! Aren't I a good girl?!
If I apprehend the suspect today, you need to give me some extra head pats, all right?
The Commander will let you tease him for being a puppy. But not too much.
Aaaah~ Why hasn't Commander shown up...
I wonder where the Commander is? I thought we agreed the two of us would go on patrol today.
Do you want to come to the police station? I won't arrest you, pinky swear!
I just feel like kicking back and relaxing, ya know?
Wowzers, why are there so many cases in such a small place? Pretty weird, don't ya think?
*Sniff* If there's anything you can trust, it's this snout of mine! I'll protect you!
Wowee, I'll take good care of it!
My nose has become more sensitive, don't ya think?
Thank you for your support, Commander!
This is my favorite!
It's... a gift! Thanks!
Whoaaa! Thank you for this!
I can't express how grateful I am, Commander. You can count on me!
The Commander. My job... I'm equally fond of both!
You're under arrest... for stealing my heart!
Mind if I join?
Where should I go?
Position confirmed, let's go!
Moving!
Enemy sighted!
Engaging!
Let's get this show on the road!
Reloading!
Let me catch my breath!
Taking cover!
Ready to strike!
Police officer Poli is here! Let me be your escort!
I'll get them all!
Suspects detained!
That should do it!
Searching for next target.
Argh!
Uh...
Arh!
Erm... I'm just going to take a short break...
You did well, Commander!
